decisions.reason: A polymer concrete drain housing is a durable platform component of compatible product families, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's core strategic direction, and the product moved up to its own page in 2019.
Designer drains face style turnover and the product slipped from its own page to a mention in 2019, but they still fit the design-focused positioning.
A shower element with integrated slope supports the trend toward low-profile, accessible renovation solutions, even though it got only modest website presence.
The backflow-protected basement drain was featured on its own page and on the home page and meets a lasting flood-protection need.
An air-admittance valve is a low-cost complementary accessory that rounds out the drainage range, though it is peripheral to the core business.
